note: Doc 24, which fills doc 06's combination table -- specified in the technical spec and never written until now. THREE TIERS, resolved most specific first: an authored pair, then the item's own pool, then the global pool. Doc 24's own instruction is not to add pairs merely to avoid a pool: the fork pool is funnier than forty fork pairs would be, because a pool is a character's relationship to the world rather than to one object.
rule4: Doc 24 note 4. No authored pair may exist without a written line. A combination that should do something and has none is REPORTED as unwritten and never falls through to a pool -- a pool line in place of a missing pair is a gap that looks like content, which is the same silent failure the item-name uniqueness check exists to prevent.

pairs.say: Four minutes. It is the first honest work done in this building in some time.
pairs.targetPending: Doc 02 A2. Room 18 is not built.

pairs.say: I have stopped the draft with a horse blanket. The hole has gone cold. We shall see what the raccoon makes of that.
pairs.targetPending: Doc 02 A5. Prosperity is not built.

pairs.say: Four minutes. C-sharp has come home, and nobody in this room has looked up.
Filed. Mr Sump has written a number in a book, and the number is mine.
pairs.targetPending: Doc 02 A9. Room 7 exists; doc 05 marks its hotspot list a working script and the counter is not among the five wired.

pairs.say: Two dollars, for a number in a book. He has taken it without looking at me, which I am told is the correct procedure.
pairs.targetPending: Doc 02 A9. Sump is a character, not scenery -- he arrives with the minor character trees doc 15 lists as sketched only.

pairs.say: Paper. It absorbs. I have learned nothing and I am going to do it again.
Nothing. Mud does not resonate. I have now established that experimentally and I would like it forgotten.
He has heard it. He has decided against having an opinion.
Four hundred yards away, and I have struck a tuning fork at it. I am aware.
Gilt over pine. It sounds like pine.
He is warmer than I am.
I have compared the map to the hills. The hills are winning.
I have shown the mud its deed. The mud is unmoved, which is the correct response and I resent it.

pairs.note: ERRATA 66 A-C: SHOW / USE the submission log on Winnie is C5. The target is the room's ambient character, not a hotspot. No `say`: the pair's line is WIN_B2's opening, which the action launches at once. The log is kept. With C5 complete the pair yields to the ordinary pools (doc 36 Q113).

tuning_fork: I have struck it against it. The fork is still A. The world is unchanged.
That cannot be tuned. I have established this experimentally, which tells you something about my week.
A. Four hundred and forty. Everything else remains as it was.
Nothing. I am beginning to think the fault is not with the fork.
horse_blanket: It is a blanket. It goes over things, or under them, and that is the whole of its range.
I have put a blanket on it. Nothing has improved.
company_map: It is a map. It tells me where things are. It does not do anything to them.
I have held a map against it. We are both embarrassed.
deed: I am not going to wave a legal document at it.
It is a paper saying that forty feet of mud belongs to me. It has no further powers.
letter: It is sealed and it is addressed to a dead man. I am not opening it for this.
four_dollars: That is money, and that is not a thing money buys.
I have four dollars. I am not spending them on that.
filing_fee: That is money, and that is not a thing money buys.
I have four dollars. I am not spending them on that.
pickaxe: I could. I have thought about it. I am not going to.
That would be destruction of property, and at least a third of the property is mine.

itemPoolNote: Rotated in order, so a line never follows itself -- the same rule doc 13 sets for the verb pools. Doc 24 note 1: the fork pool is the highest-traffic piece of writing in Act I, because striking the fork against things is what the character does and the player finds that out within minutes.
globalPool: That accomplishes nothing I can see.
No. They are two separate objects and I should like them to remain so.
I have tried it. Nothing about the arrangement improved.
I do not know what I expected.
